description: This file defines the SplashActivity for an Android TV application. It displays a splash screen with a dark background using a minimal layout, then transitions to MainActivity after a short delay of 600 milliseconds.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: This class represents a splash screen activity for Android TV, showing a themed minimal splash screen before transitioning to the main activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles the activity creation lifecycle, sets the minimal layout, and schedules the transition to MainActivity after a brief delay.
